title: Public ISRO/NISAR S-band GCOV sample
notes: This public sample proves the S-band GCOV extraction path, but it is not co-located or time-matched with the Nagapattinam L-band evidence.
It is shown for provenance and pipeline validation only; it must not be used to calculate a Nagapattinam moisture or irrigation decision.
A true L/S fused layer requires an S-band product for the same area, compatible acquisition, grid, polarization, and processing convention.
